🧭 COUNTY-CARVED STATE MAZES

MD · DE · NJ · NY · Québec — each maze is carved from the real state/province outline and real county or MRC lines (U.S. Census Bureau boundary data for the states; Québec's real municipalité régionale de comté boundaries for the province). Crossing between regions is only possible at one or two real shared-border “doorways” per pair, so the map itself shapes the path.

How to play: Trace a single path from START to FINISH without crossing any walls. Bold lines are real county/MRC or state/province borders; thin lines are maze walls. The Québec maze omits its vast, sparsely-populated far-north territories (Nord-du-Québec and the North Shore) and one remote Gulf island chain (Îles-de-la-Madeleine, shown as outline only) to keep the carved area focused on the populated St. Lawrence corridor the trip actually visits. Solutions are at the end if you get stuck.
